g.text: Detailed Run, Storage and State Contracts

text.tspan: State separation is deliberate: run lifecycle describes execution progress; analysis availability governs whether a result can be used; coordinate-record QC describes audit completeness.
The evidence register is additive and run-local. It does not replace source tables or convert a missing domain call into a biological negative result.
repository - data - runs - packages - cache - logs
local Python runtime + LRZ SSH / Slurm profile
no embedded machine-local absolute paths in runs
canonical runs + examples + registered external roots
ambiguous run IDs fail instead of guessing
registry change without deleting scientific data
run_id - dataset_id - layout / schema - path references
run state - current step - production identity
source records and frozen cluster input
MSA, comparable groups and cross-species results
describe historical paths without rewriting them
created - precluster running - cluster input ready
postcluster running - website indices building - running
results ready - results partial - partial - failed
derive honest status from on-disk artifacts and logs
refresh, retry preparation / precluster, start post-InterPro
coding exons - internal junctions - unique proteins
single exon - single protein - single species
UI gate + figure catalogue + package capabilities
pre_cluster: exon intervals + pending domain evidence
post_cluster: refreshed domain, TM and boundary relations
run / analysis / dataset + species / transcript / protein
source file + source row + run reports + post-cluster QC
unique result types + safe paths + size / checksum match
canonical packages live outside the run directory
